newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse slides ahead of election results.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse slides ahead of election results.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange which has been depressed by uncertainty in the run-up to elections, slumped on Monday as results from voting on Sunday were awaited.
The GSE All-Share index fell 5.1 points, one of its biggest session falls this year, to 356.95 points.
Offers totalled 1,337,960 shares compared to bids of 193,030 shares.
Market analysts said investors were now focusing on inflation and interest rate worries with the presidential and parliamentary elections out of the way.

Full results from Sunday's voting were not yet out as the the bourse closed, but President Jerry Rawlings appeared well on course to re-election with a parliamentary majority during afternoon trading.

Rawlings, a former socialist military ruler who switched to free-market policies and democracy, won praise for market reforms he introduced. But the economy is in the grip of inflationary pressure, runaway interest rates and serious unemployment.
